name: Farther Reach
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS allows you to grab objects and players from farther away (from 30 studs away instead of 20 studs away). It also changes what your Grab Line looks like.

name: Escape Faster
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS allows you to able to escape from someone's grasp in 4 seconds or less instead of 12 seconds or less.

name: Multi-Color Line
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS allows you to make your Grab Line nine different colors at once instead of just one color.

name: Raised Toys Limit
displayDescription:
This GAMEPASS raises Your Toys Limit from 100 to 200.
(The 600 limit for houses will still be a 600 limit)

name: Infinite House Time
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS makes it so you will never be removed from the house's list by staying away for too long. You will still get removed from the house's list if you claim a different house or become a Requester on a different house.

name: Earn More Coins
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS makes Coin Machines give you an extra 50 coins every time you use one.

name: More House Saves
displayDescription: This GAMEPASS gives you access to the extra house save files.
